summary.description: Markdown, at most 200 words: how the tickets cover the epic Done-when, the order to build them in, Open (gaps and the default you used), and anything you left out and why (procedure plan-epic.md).

tickets.description: The child tickets of the epic, in build order. Each becomes a ticket in Ideas only after Andy approves.

title.description: What changes for the user or the system, in plain words.

type.description: feature: a user-visible change; chore: internal work; bug: a fix; spike: a time-boxed question. Never an epic.

size.description: S: under a day; M: one to two days; L: up to a week. Prefer S and M.

body.description: Markdown: why, what, and how it is verified.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Checks for done. Features in EARS form ("When …, the system shall …").

touches.description: Path globs or areas it expects to edit, from the repo as it is.

blockedBy.description: 0-based indexes of other tickets in this list it cannot start before. No self, no cycle.
